changes.title: Ring runestones
items: The dancefloor ring's runestones stand as tall as an area's runestone, carved and mossed the same, at half its width, before the boot turns each into its speaker

changes.title: No familiars
items: No more familiars: the cat, crow, toad and bat are gone from the character creator and from the other witches at the party, so the only animals are the forest's own (a saved witch with one simply loads without it)

changes.title: Creator swatches
items: The character creator's colours are now a grid of swatches: twelve hues and a grey column, from deep shades down to pale tints. Tap or click one to dress her (your saved witch keeps her look, moved to the nearest swatch)
